entries.title: .cursor/rules, Better Codebase Understanding, New Tab Model
entries.titleJa: Cursor 0.45リリース: .cursor/rules、コードベース理解強化、新タブモデル
entries.titleEn: .cursor/rules, Better Codebase Understanding, New Tab Model
entries.summaryJa: Cursorはバージョン0.45で、プロジェクト固有のAIルールを管理する.cursor/rulesディレクトリ、コードベース全体の理解を高めるエージェント機能、文脈認識を改善した新しいタブ補完モデルを導入した。Fusionタブの精度向上やAgent機能の安定化も含む。
entries.summaryEn: Cursor 0.45 introduces a new .cursor/rules directory for per-project AI rules, improved codebase-wide understanding via the Agent, and a new tab completion model with better context awareness and accuracy.
entries.bodyJa:
AI統合エディタCursorのバージョン0.45では、開発者がプロジェクト単位でAIの挙動を細かくカスタマイズできる仕組みと、コードベース全体を踏まえた提案精度の向上が中心テーマとなっている。

最も注目される変更は、新しい.cursor/rulesディレクトリの導入だ。従来は単一の.cursorrulesファイルでプロジェクト全体のAI指示を管理していたが、新方式では複数のルールファイルをディレクトリ内に配置し、特定のファイルパターンやコンテキストごとに適用範囲を切り替えられる。モノレポや言語混在プロジェクトでの運用性が向上すると見られる。

コードベース理解の改善では、Agent機能がプロジェクト構造をより広範に把握し、複数ファイルにまたがる変更や依存関係を考慮した編集を行えるようになった。加えて新しいタブ補完モデルが導入され、カーソル周辺の局所的な文脈だけでなく、プロジェクト全体の状態を反映したサジェストを返すように改良されている。

背景として、AIコーディング支援ツールの競争は激化しており、GitHub CopilotのWorkspace機能、Anthropic製Claude CodeやAider、Windsurfなど、リポジトリ全体を文脈として扱うアプローチが主流になりつつある。Cursorの.cursor/rulesはAnthropicのCLAUDE.mdやContinueの設定ファイルと思想的に近く、プロジェクト固有の規約をAIに継続的に守らせる「AI向けコーディング規約」とも言える存在だ。

また、ルールをディレクトリ化してバージョン管理に組み込む動きは、チーム開発でのAI挙動の再現性確保という観点でも重要度を増している。今後はこれらルールの記述ベストプラクティスやコミュニティ製テンプレートの蓄積が進む可能性がある。
entries.bodyEn:
Cursor's 0.45 release centers on two themes: giving developers finer-grained control over AI behavior on a per-project basis, and improving how the assistant reasons about an entire codebase rather than just the file in front of the user.

The headline change is the introduction of a .cursor/rules directory. Previously, projects relied on a single .cursorrules file to encode project-wide instructions for the AI — coding conventions, preferred libraries, architectural constraints, and so on. The new model lets teams break those instructions into multiple rule files, each scoped to particular file patterns or contexts. For monorepos or polyglot projects where a single flat ruleset becomes unwieldy, this should make AI behavior more predictable and easier to maintain.

The second major area is improved codebase understanding. The Agent feature can now reason more broadly across project structure, handling multi-file edits and cross-cutting dependencies with more awareness. Alongside this, Cursor ships a new tab completion model that takes a wider context window into account when suggesting completions, so suggestions reflect not just the local cursor position but also the broader state of the repository. Users should notice fewer suggestions that conflict with code defined elsewhere in the project.

In context, this release fits a clear industry trend. AI coding tools are converging on the idea that the unit of context is the repository, not the file. GitHub Copilot Workspace, Anthropic's Claude Code, open-source tools like Aider, and competitors such as Windsurf all lean heavily on whole-repo retrieval and project-aware planning. Cursor's .cursor/rules is conceptually similar to Anthropic's CLAUDE.md convention or Continue's configuration files: a checked-in, version-controlled artifact that tells the AI how this particular project wants to be treated. Think of it as a coding standards document written for an LLM rather than for a human reviewer.

There are likely longer-term implications for team workflows. Once AI rules live in a directory under source control, they become reviewable, diffable, and shareable like any other code. That opens the door to rule templates for common stacks, shared rule libraries within organizations, and possibly community-curated rule sets for popular frameworks. It also raises questions about rule precedence and conflict resolution as files multiply, though these are problems Cursor will likely refine over subsequent point releases.

For existing users, migration from .cursorrules to the new directory format appears straightforward, and the older file is expected to remain supported for backward compatibility. Teams already invested in heavy AI-assisted workflows may find the biggest immediate gains from the new tab model and Agent improvements, while the rules directory pays off most in larger, more structured projects.

entries.title: Announcing The Stargate Project
entries.titleJa: OpenAI、5000億ドル規模のStargate Projectを発表
entries.summaryJa: OpenAIはOracle、SoftBank、MGXと共同で、米国内のAIインフラ構築に4年間で5000億ドルを投じる新合弁会社「Stargate」を発表した。即時に1000億ドルを投入し、テキサス州で建設を開始。AGI実現に向けた計算基盤の確保と数十万人規模の雇用創出を目指す。
entries.summaryEn: OpenAI, Oracle, SoftBank and MGX have launched Stargate, a new joint venture investing $500 billion over four years to build AI infrastructure in the US, with $100 billion deployed immediately and construction already underway in Texas.
entries.bodyJa:
OpenAIは2025年1月、SoftBank、Oracle、アブダビの投資会社MGXと共同で新会社「The Stargate Project」を設立し、今後4年間で米国内のAIインフラに最大5000億ドルを投じると発表した。うち1000億ドルは即時に投入される。SoftBankが資金面、OpenAIが運用面の責任を主導し、SoftBankの孫正義氏が会長に就く。

初期パートナーとしてはMicrosoft、NVIDIA、Arm、Oracleが技術提供で参画する。建設はすでにテキサス州アビリーンで始まっており、米国全土の候補地でキャンパス展開を検討中とされる。OpenAIはこれにより数十万人の雇用が生まれ、AGI(汎用人工知能)実現に向けた計算資源の確保と、米国および同盟国の戦略的優位の維持につながると説明している。

背景には、フロンティアモデルの学習・推論に要する計算需要の急膨張がある。GPT-4以降のスケーリングでは、モデル規模だけでなく、推論側のチェーン・オブ・ソート計算(o1系のような推論時計算)も電力・GPUを大量に消費する傾向が強まっている。Microsoft Azureとの既存契約は維持されつつ、Stargateで新規容量を上積みする構図と見られる。

業界ではAmazonがAnthropicへ巨額出資しTrainiumクラスタを構築、GoogleもTPU v5pで自社モデルを支える等、ハイパースケーラー間のインフラ軍拡が加速している。Stargateはこの潮流の中でも突出した規模で、米政府による国家安全保障的な後押しも示唆されており、半導体輸出規制やエネルギー供給(原子力・SMR含む)を巡る議論と連動して進む可能性がある。
entries.bodyEn:
OpenAI announced in January 2025 the formation of The Stargate Project, a new joint venture with SoftBank, Oracle and Abu Dhabi-based investor MGX that intends to invest up to $500 billion over the next four years to build AI infrastructure in the United States. An initial $100 billion is being deployed immediately. SoftBank will lead financial responsibilities while OpenAI takes operational responsibility, with SoftBank chairman Masayoshi Son serving as chairman of the venture.

Microsoft, NVIDIA, Arm and Oracle are named as key initial technology partners. Construction is already underway at a campus in Abilene, Texas, with additional sites across the country reportedly under evaluation. OpenAI frames the project as a vehicle to create hundreds of thousands of American jobs, secure the compute capacity needed to pursue AGI, and reinforce US and allied strategic leadership in AI.

The announcement reflects a sharp escalation in the compute demands of frontier model development. Beyond pretraining ever-larger models, the rise of inference-time reasoning systems such as OpenAI's o1 family has shifted significant load to serving infrastructure, where extended chains of thought consume far more GPU-seconds per query than conventional chat completions. Stargate appears designed to layer net-new capacity on top of OpenAI's existing relationship with Microsoft Azure rather than replace it, although the precise division of workloads has not been disclosed.

The move comes amid an intensifying infrastructure arms race among hyperscalers and model labs. Amazon has committed billions to Anthropic and is scaling Trainium-based clusters, Google continues to expand TPU v5p capacity for Gemini, Meta is building out hundreds of thousands of H100-class GPUs, and xAI brought its Memphis Colossus cluster online in record time. Even within that context, a half-trillion-dollar headline figure is unprecedented, and execution will hinge on power availability, grid interconnects and chip supply rather than capital alone.

The political backdrop is also notable. The announcement was made alongside the incoming US administration, signaling a posture in which large-scale AI buildout is treated as a matter of national competitiveness vis-à-vis China. That framing could dovetail with ongoing debates over semiconductor export controls, domestic fab incentives under the CHIPS Act, and novel energy procurement strategies — including the small modular reactor and behind-the-meter gas deals that several hyperscalers have begun to explore. How quickly Stargate can translate pledged capital into energized megawatts and racked GPUs will likely determine whether the project reshapes the competitive landscape or simply matches it.
